AI4Science Lab Meeting

1 October 2026

ChemAI 2026

AI Technology for Molecules and Materials

On November 12–13, ChemAI returns to Amsterdam for its 2026 edition, bringing together researchers, industry, startups, and investors working at the intersection of AI, robotics, quantum and chemistry, materials science, and pharma.

  • Day 1 – Nov 12 – 12:00-18:00 – “ChemAI Deep Tech Builders” - AI House – Focused on the future of Deep Tech: entrepreneurs, innovators, investors, corporates, and ecosystem leaders
  • Day 2 – Nov 13 – 9:00-19:00 - “ChemAI Conference” – Hotel Casa – A full day of keynotes, talks, panels, company exhibition, networking, and a poster session, with participants from academia and industry

The program features keynotes from world-leading researchers and innovators, including:

  • Prof. Max Welling – CTO & founder of CuspAI
  • Dr. Heike Riel – IBM Head of Quantum & AI, President of the German Physical Society
  • Prof. Timothy Noël – University of Amsterdam
  • Dr. Erik Bekkers - University of Amsterdam
  • Prof. Steven Latré – VP of AI at IMEC
  • Prof. Tonio Buonassisi – VP of Sustainable Energy at CSEM
  • Dr. Yang Cao – Staff Scientist at Acceleration Consortium, University of Toronto
  • … and many more, including University of Toronto, NYU, TUM, Siemens, NVIDIA, TOPSOE, VSParticle, Quantinuum, etc.

The poster session offers researchers an opportunity to present their work, with cash prizes awarded to the top three posters thanks to Matterstack.ai. The company exhibition connects researchers, startups, and industry.

  • ChemAI Website: https://www.acnetwork.nl/chemai
  • Program: https://www.canva.com/design/DAHNYv4GNIg/D9jRaLM-Y6_6pP7SHfoDuQ/view
  • Day 1 registrations: https://luma.com/aihouse-eyno
  • Day 2 registrations: https://www.eventbrite.nl/e/chemai-2026-day-2-conference-nov-13-tickets-1994828364337 (recommended for academics)

We warmly encourage you to share this invitation with colleagues, PhD students, research groups, and industry connections who may be interested in the rapidly developing field of AI for molecules and materials.

About This Site

The AI4Science Lab is an initiative supported by the Faculty of Science (FNWI) at the University of Amsterdam and located in the Informatics Institute (IvI). The AI4Science Lab is also connected to AMLAB, the Amsterdam Machine Learning Lab. We develop and use machine learning techniques to discover patterns in data streams produced by experiments in a wide variety of scientific fields, ranging from ecology to molecular biology and from chemistry to astrophysics.
